instructions.value: Participants viewed palatable high-calorie food pictures and applied one of three cognitive control strategies: think about the negative consequences of eating the food for weight, health, and appearance; look neutrally at the food cue and immediately inhibit thoughts or cravings related to its palatability; or increase cravings by actively imagining the food's delicious smell, taste, and texture. In the passive viewing run, participants pressed a button when a dot appeared in the center of a food picture.
